title: POST /api/client/control
description: REST twin of WS control for devices on the hub path (e.g. without an open WebSocket). Authorization: Bearer <client secret>; 401 for an unknown, revoked or deleted device. Answers: 200 control_ok, 403 rule_blocked or control_error {not_hub_controlled|not_visible}, 422 control_error {invalid_request}, 409 {not_ready}, 502 {ha_error}, 503 {ha_unavailable} (bodies = schemas/ws/server/*).
